summary: Selected Pro proposal 6, the only proposal surviving opponent review, and exhaustively tested affine/Graver isolation on one falsified OR core. Every degree-one left-regular 12-column matrix with one or two rows retains a squared-norm-2 harmful signed move. Among all 531441 three-row matrices, 18 isolate the harmful fiber in the tested coefficient box [-3,3]; the other matrices have minimum harmful squared norm 2 or 4. This is a bounded finite survivor, not a reduction or asymptotic lemma.
hypothesis: A sparse affine measurement matrix may exclude exact signed local-pattern relaxations by giving the relevant integer affine fiber no short harmful kernel direction.

tests.finding: Covered all degree-one left-regular 12-column matrices with 1-3 rows. Counts were 1, 4096, and 531441; exactly 18 three-row matrices isolated the tested harmful fiber, while no one- or two-row matrix did.

next_experiment: Take the representative three-row isolating matrix and compose two overlapping OR-clause selector blocks sharing a global variable. Perform exact low-weight search, including auxiliary directions, to test whether cross-clause correlated kernel moves restore a signed cheat; then test column degree two only if the overlap instance still isolates.
